response.original_title: 片山萌美 もう一度、わたしをみて ~Re:start~
response.overview: A mature romance unfolds against the backdrop of Nagasaki. Like a fine, well-aged wine, a rich and captivating time unfolds where genuine beauty radiates from within, seamlessly blending tension and relaxation. Celebrating the 10th anniversary of her debut, actress Moemi Katayama reaches her ultimate artistic peak in this complete masterpiece!! High-definition Blu-ray is also released simultaneously!
